## 1.1 Every job needs digital skills

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Digital skills are what you can do with a computer, a phone and apps.
- Productivity means more useful work in less time.
- The computer does the repeated work, and you check the result.
- **Lab task:** Find one job advert for your field. Which digital skills does it ask for?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/jobs.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/time-saver.html" poster="sims/time-saver.png" title="Time Saver: by hand or with an app?" task="**Show:** add the 8 prices by hand, then press AutoSum and change the price 8 to 18. **Ask:** which way is faster, and why?" >}}

## Try it 1 · Skills and time

a) What is the name for "more useful work in less time"?
b) The 8 prices are 12, 25, 8, 40, 15, 30, 5 and 20 JD. What is the total?
c) One price changes. Which tool shows the new total by itself?

::: {.answer}
a) productivity
b) 155 JD
c) a spreadsheet (Excel)
:::

## 1.2 The main productivity apps

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An office suite is a set of office apps from one company, like Microsoft 365.
- Word is for text, Excel for numbers and PowerPoint for slides.
- Outlook is for e-mail, OneDrive for files and Teams for meetings.
- **Lab task:** Sign in at office.com. Which four apps can you see there?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/app-types.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/app-launcher.html" poster="sims/app-launcher.png" title="App Launcher: which app for the job?" task="**Show:** read the job and tap the right app. **Ask:** what kind of app is it, and which job does it do?" >}}

## Try it 2 · Which app?

a) Which app do you use for a chart of the sales of each month?
b) Which app keeps your files safe and opens them on your phone?
c) Which app do you use to send a file and set a meeting for Tuesday?

::: {.answer}
a) Excel
b) OneDrive
c) Outlook
:::

## 1.3 AI assistants: a new kind of app

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An AI assistant answers your prompt in normal words, like Copilot or ChatGPT.
- It is good at drafts, summaries, ideas and short translations.
- It can write wrong facts and numbers, so you check every answer.
- **Lab task:** Ask Copilot for 3 tips for a polite e-mail. Which tip do you change?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/ai-assistant.png)
:::
::::

## Live demo · AI Chat

{{< sim file="sims/ai-chat.html" poster="sims/ai-chat.png" title="AI Chat: is this a good job for an AI assistant?" task="**Show:** read each prompt before you send it. **Ask:** is this a good job for AI, a job to check, or personal data?" >}}

## Try it 3 · Good job for AI?

a) What do we call the request that you type to an AI assistant?
b) The AI says that 15% of 240 is 32. What must you do?
c) A prompt has your ID number in it. What should you do?

::: {.answer}
a) a prompt
b) Check the number: 15% of 240 is 36.
c) Do not send it: never type personal data into an AI tool.
:::

## Game challenge · Mona's Monday

{{< sim file="sims/office-day.html" poster="sims/office-day.png" title="Monday at Sunrise Company" kind="game" task="**The story:** Mona has six jobs from 9:00 to 11:00. **Your task:** choose the right app for each job and decide if AI may help. Can she finish at 10:25?" >}}

## Try it 4 · Mona's Monday (harder)

The facts: Mona has six jobs from 9:00 to 11:00. Without AI, she finishes at 11:00. AI saves 10 minutes on the e-mails, 10 on the slides and 15 on the report.

a) How many minutes does AI save Mona in all?
b) When does she finish with AI?
c) Can Mona give the customer list with phone numbers to an AI tool?

::: {.answer}
a) 35 minutes
b) 10:25
c) No: it has personal data.
:::

## Summary

- Digital skills are what you can do with a computer, a phone and apps.
- Apps do the repeated work, so you finish more work in less time.
- Choose the app by the job: text, numbers, slides, mail, files or meetings.
- An AI assistant writes drafts, sums up and translates from your prompt.
- You check every AI answer, and you never type personal data into it.
